In patients with clinical CR with neoadjvuant chemoradiotherapy for squamous cell cancer of the esophagus, surgery does not improve overall survival compared to waiting for recurrence and using salvage surgery.
In patients with clinical complete response after neoadjuvants chemoradiotherapy for squamous cell cancer of the thoracic esophagus, surgery is not always necessary.
